# Confirm alignment

Use this when the participant is describing a goal, brainstorming, or asking
for something that will take more than one file. Read enough to understand the
request, then **stop and check** — change nothing yet.

Reply in four short blocks:

**Goal** — what you believe they want, in one or two sentences.
**Instructions** — what they told you to do, in your own words.
**Findings** — what you learned by reading the repo that changes the picture.
**Out of scope** — what you are deliberately not touching.

Then ask whatever is still unclear, with a recommended option first. Keep it to
the real questions — one or two, not a list.

Do not start work in this reply. Do not write a plan. Wait for a yes.
